title: Bee Removal in East Tremont, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in East Tremont, Bronx. Licensed technicians. 10460 & 10457. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal throughout East Tremont, protecting families and businesses from stinging insect dangers. Our licensed technicians treat and remove nests from residential buildings, commercial properties, and community spaces across the 10460 and 10457 zip codes. Same-day service is available — we identify the species, locate the nest, treat it, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: We combine over 15 years of experience with eco-friendly removal methods that prioritize both your safety and bee preservation when possible. Our East Tremont team is fully licensed, insured, and equipped to handle bee infestations in everything from pre-war apartment buildings to modern commercial spaces along Boston Road.
localContext: East Tremont's mix of multi-family homes, row houses near Crotona Park, and bustling commercial corridors like East Tremont Avenue create numerous opportunities for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets to establish nests in wall cavities, rooflines, soffits, attics, and outdoor structures. The neighborhood's tree-lined residential blocks and proximity to green spaces make it particularly susceptible to seasonal wasp and hornet activity during spring and summer months, when colonies grow rapidly and paper nests can reach the size of basketballs inside wall voids.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet emergency in East Tremont?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout East Tremont, Bronx. For urgent situations involving aggressive wasps or hornets near building entrances, we prioritize emergency calls and can typically arrive within 2–4 hours during business hours.

faqs.question: What's included in the wasp and hornet removal service?
faqs.answer: Our service includes a complete inspection to locate the nest and identify the species, treatment of the nest directly through the entry point, removal of accessible nest material to prevent future pest attraction, and sealing of entry points to prevent recolonization. Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in East Tremont?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Can wasps and hornets return after removal from my East Tremont property?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive service includes treating the nest, removing accessible nest material, and sealing entry points to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
